promise: Offer a free-case programme for eligible iPhone 4 purchases through September 30, 2010, with reimbursement for eligible Apple Bumper purchases
description: Apple announced a free-case programme on July 16, 2010 and opened applications on July 23. It covered eligible iPhone 4 purchases through September 30, with separate claim windows, and offered reimbursement to eligible buyers of Apple Bumpers.
evidence: Contemporaneous July 23, 2010 reporting confirms that the free-case application programme opened, retained purchase eligibility through September 30, and provided reimbursement procedures. This rates implementation of the offer, not proof that every individual claim was settled.
